title.zh: 没有调查，没有发言权：这句话原本要求什么
title.en: No Investigation, No Right to Speak: What the Line Originally Asked For

dek.zh: 1930年5月，毛泽东写下这句话。原文其实很具体：调查会要几个人、请谁来、谁来做记录；十一年后他又交代，自己是向一个穷秀才、一个破产的商会会长和一个失业的钱粮小吏学的。
dek.en: Mao Zedong wrote the line in May 1930. The essay behind it is concrete: how many people an inquiry meeting needs, whom to invite, who keeps the notes. Eleven years later he named his teachers: a poor scholar, a bankrupt merchant and an unemployed tax clerk.

title.zh: 欠饷是真的，匿名信也是真的：华盛顿在纽堡站在哪里
title.en: The Pay Was Really Owed, the Letters Really Anonymous: Where Washington Stood at Newburgh

dek.zh: 1783年3月，独立战争快打完了，军官们的饷还欠着。有人用匿名信劝他们把请愿从讲理改成施压，甚至留了撤走的后路。华盛顿本不打算到场，最后还是去了。
dek.en: In March 1783, with the Revolutionary War nearly over, the officers' back pay was still unpaid. Anonymous letters urged them to turn their petition from persuasion into pressure, and even mapped an exit. Washington had not planned to be there. In the end he was.

title.zh: 快要毕业时，一百个留学生被叫回国
title.en: Just Before Graduation, a Hundred Students Were Called Home

dek.zh: 一百二十个孩子被派去美国，计划读十五年。第九年，约一百人被召回。叫停他们的不是一件事，而是一连串报告、拒绝、奏折与征询。
dek.en: One hundred and twenty boys were sent to America on a fifteen-year plan. In the ninth year, about a hundred were recalled. What ended it was not one event but a chain of reports, refusals, a memorial and a round of consultations.

title.zh: 拆掉水泵把手，宽街的霍乱就停了吗？
title.en: Did Removing the Pump Handle Really Stop the Cholera in Broad Street?

dek.zh: 1854年伦敦宽街，一口公共水泵的把手被拆掉。提出建议的医生自己提醒：病例在那之前已经在下降。把证据链补上的，是一位本以为能推翻水泵说的牧师。
dek.en: In 1854 London, the handle of a public pump in Broad Street was taken off on a doctor's advice. The doctor himself warned that cases were already declining before then. The man who closed the gap in the chain of evidence was a clergyman who had set out to disprove the pump theory.

title.zh: 韩信、陈平、范增：项羽留不住的三个人
title.en: Han Xin, Chen Ping, Fan Zeng: The Three Men Xiang Yu Could Not Keep

dek.zh: 汉之三年，荥阳被围，汉王用四万斤金买一条离间计。同一场战争前后，项羽身边走了三个人——韩信、陈平、范增，走的理由各不相同，指向的却是同一件事。
dek.en: In the third year of the Han, with Xingyang under siege, the King of Han paid forty thousand catties of gold for a single stratagem of mistrust. Across that same war, three men left Xiang Yu's side — Han Xin, Chen Ping, and Fan Zeng — each for a different reason, and all three pointing at the same question: could Xiang Yu hold on to people?
